title: CRIC Repository and System Architecture
summary: Defines CRIC repository boundaries, dependency rules, deployment models, canonical versus materialised data, identifier form, interface contracts and release requirements for the multi-repository ecosystem.
notes: No frontmatter, no Decision/Consequences, no user stories or acceptance criteria. Dominant content is implementation contracts: dependency rules, DataAsset YAML field schema, CRIC:<namespace>:<type>:<ulid> identifier form, interface contract list (Pydantic/JSON Schema/STAC/OpenAPI/MCP), release artefact list, and directory structures for cric-review and agent workspaces -> SPEC. Competing PRD signal comes only from the containing path (docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/product/) and the 'v0.1 Architectural Requirement' section; ambiguity resolved by precedence (SPEC > PRD). Confidence medium: content signals only, path convention disagrees. No markdown links to other documents; CITATION.cff is mentioned as a per-release artefact, not as a document reference, so cross_refs left empty.
